lockReason: User accepted the sheet after replacing 2.1's odd independently moving staff with an aggressive mace plus open spell hand. This gives wizard and warlock sufficient shared coverage without expanding into separate class-specific weapon ladders.

columns.1: staff caster / wizard, except 2.1 changed to mace + spell hand

matrix.1.1: balanced staff caster: grounded magical staff, relaxed off hand
matrix.1.2: balanced body caster: empty hands, low dark spell beginning
matrix.1.3: balanced hybrid: staff carried/strapped, empty off hand
matrix.2.1: aggressive mace plus open spell hand, no staff
matrix.2.2: aggressive body caster: open hand thrust forward, dark spell emerging
matrix.2.3: aggressive hybrid: short blade and open spell hand
matrix.3.1: defensive staff caster: staff braced close
matrix.3.2: defensive body caster: warding hand, dark spell held close
matrix.3.3: defensive hybrid: staff carried/behind, front hand warding

coverageDecision: Together with the trimmed humanoid armed pool and locked cleric matrix, this is enough weapon/shield/spell pose coverage for now. Future work should prioritize cutouts, anchors, base-fit checks, and species/body compatibility rather than more weapon variants.
notes: This is a locked review sheet, not production cutouts.
Wizard identity comes from staff-casting cells.
Warlock identity comes from body/open-hand casting cells.
Do not expand to exhaustive class x weapon x posture coverage unless playtesting reveals a real silhouette gap.
